title: A GENERAL FRAMEWORK FOR OPTIMISING COST-EFFECTIVENESS OF PANDEMIC RESPONSE UNDER PARTIAL INTERVENTION MEASURES
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for optimizing public health interventions by balancing economic costs and health benefits (measured in DALYs). While decisions about the value of life (willingness to pay) have ethical dimensions, the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark ethical, moral, or religious frameworks. Its purpose is optimization within a given set of economic and epidemiological parameters.
